Halo up, mis abejas. 👑✨ September 5th belongs to the Queen and Azúcar's Main Floor is turning into a full gold-sequin shrine for Beyoncé's birthday — plus the 20th anniversary of B'Day. Rohla Blunt hosts, with Dillon running the room right alongside her, and the stage is stacked: Freedom, Slayoncé, and Abele bringing the Bey energy all night, DJ EMXP keeping the floor moving. This is the kind of night you tell your group chat about before it even happens. Tables are limited — hit up Rohla Blunt or Dillon directly, or message our Facebook page to lock yours in free. Doors open, the gold comes out, and Pasco pays tribute the only way we know how: loud, glam, and unforgettable. Get your tickets now — this one sells out. 🐝✨

📅 Saturday, September 5 | Doors 8PM, Show 9:30PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$20
🔞 21+
